opening.argument: The speaker describes starting a career from zero and learning digital marketing, while the visible presentation is titled “Value Of Digital Marketing.” The description promotes Forsage and network marketing as a business opportunity. Those are promotional claims about a business and a field of work, but the supplied material does not state a specific earnings promise or payment requirement. It also shows no request for credentials or account control, and does not establish how participants would be compensated or whether earnings depend on recruitment. The business invitation warrants scrutiny, but on this evidence it does not establish a deceptive promise or a substantiated recruitment-dependent earnings structure.
